//: Single source of truth for Nix packages, installed by `devbox global`.
shared     -> BOTH the host profile AND a project's .devcontainer/devbox.tools.json
Edit this file, then run `./upgrade-packages.sh nix` (host) and
`sandcat-sync <project>` (agent container). Do not run `devbox global add`:
this file is authoritative and is pushed with `devbox global pull --force`,
so a package removed here is removed from the profile.
Libraries and Python CLI tools do NOT belong here -- uv owns everything
Python, and python/uv-tools.txt is its manifest. Nix supplies only `uv`.
